Sonu vs State Of U.P. Thru.Secy. Deptt. Of Home ... on 11
January, 2024
Author: Pankaj Bhatia

Bench: Pankaj Bhatia
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:3528
Court No. - 12
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 12200 of 2023
Applicant :- Sonu

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru.Secy. Deptt. Of Home Lko
Counsel for Applicant :- Suyesh Pradhan
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

2. In terms of the F.I.R., it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was married with the applicant in a love marriage around six years ago, however, the applicant used to harass her for dowry and ultimately she died on 04.02.2023.
3. The counsel for the applicant argues that in the post mortem report, no injury was found over the body of the victim and the cause of death has been shown as ante mortem hanging.
Sonu vs State Of U.P. Thru.Secy. Deptt. Of Home ... on 11 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/80058047/

entities.text: Sonu vs State Of U.P. Thru.Secy. Deptt. Of Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 4. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the fact that the marriage of the applicant and the victim was a love marriage and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that soon before her death, the victim was subjected to any mental or physical torture in relation to the demand of dowry coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 07.02.2023 and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Sonu be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 66 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B, 323, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Hargaon, District Sitapur, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 11.1.2024 Arun  Sonu vs State Of U.P. Thru.Secy. Deptt. Of Home ... on 11 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/80058047/
